description: Constraints from the [country] profile. Copy this file to profiles/[your-country]/constraints.json (or .xstack/profile-constraints.json for a project-local profile), replace every [placeholder], and delete the rules that do not apply.
_how_to_use: A profile layer holds the rules that are true for every service in one government, and only there. Rules for every country belong in constraints/baseline.json. Rules for one service belong in that service's .xstack/constraints.json.
Replace every [placeholder] in the text and every YOUR-... in the patterns. The patterns are regular expressions, so a placeholder left in one will never match a real page.
Write a rule only if a machine can check it. Each one needs a source a person can look up: a page of the design system, a section of a law, a line of dpi.md.

Good places to look: (1) the design system – its stylesheet, class prefix, required header and footer; (2) house style – anything the style guide bans outright; (3) shared platforms in dpi.md – what a service must never build or ask for itself; (4) law – accessibility level, languages, data that must not be collected; (5) data formats – reserved test numbers and domains for prototypes.
Give each id a short country prefix, such as BB- or KS-, so it cannot clash with the baseline or another profile.
A service uses the layer with: "extends": ["xstack:baseline", "profile:[your-country]"]. For a project-local file, give the path instead: ".xstack/profile-constraints.json".
Test it: run xstack-check on a page built from your design system's starter template. Every rule should pass. Then break each rule on purpose and check it fails.

The format, the check types and how waivers work are in constraints/README.md. See profiles/barbados/constraints.json and profiles/kestria/constraints.json for finished layers. Keys that start with an underscore are notes; the runner ignores them.

constraints.title: Every page is built on the [name] design system
constraints.source: [link or path to the design system's page template]
constraints.fix: Start the page from the design system's page template.

constraints.title: No home-made sign-in: people sign in with [identity platform]
constraints.fix: Send the person to the national identity platform. A service never sees a password.

constraints.title: Every page offers [the other official language]
constraints.fix: Add the language switcher from the design system's header.

constraints.title: [One thing the house style bans outright]
constraints.source: [link or path to the style guide]
